1.title: One exit for everyone
1.body: Swipe the highlighted red block. It keeps sliding until stopped. Send every block through the same exit.

2.title: Obstacles stop your slide
2.body: Gray obstacles stay in place. Use them to line up the shared exit.

3.title: Yellow follows its arrow
3.body: Yellow blocks move only in their arrow direction. Red blocks can help them reach the exit.

21.title: Plan within the move budget
21.body: You have two moves beyond the shortest solution. Plan before you swipe.

22.title: Release the parent first
22.body: Blue stays locked until its connected parent leaves through the exit. Release the parent, then move Blue.

31.title: Count exits to open Purple
31.body: Purple unlocks after its numbered exit count. Send that many other blocks out first, then move Purple.
